entities.name: Brokkos
entities.description: The Forever-Beast, apex monster of the Zagoth triome on Ikoria, a gentle giant with a forest growing on its back.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who observed Brokkos hibernating under the swamp.

entities.name: Zagoth
entities.description: Triome of Ikoria where Brokkos roams.

events.summary: Vivien Reid observes Brokkos hibernating under the swamp.
events.quote: as observed by the planeswalker Vivien Reid

events.summary: In legend, Brokkos gives the first human hunter visions of past and future instead of fighting.
events.quote: Instead of fighting back, Brokkos gave the human two gifts.
